method: read-only evidence and two SQLite query_only snapshots; no API calls, inference, or runtime mutation

reviewConclusion.backend: No additional confirmed severe backend defect found in this bounded source/evidence review. The association acknowledgement defect is fixed in source and its real database regression passed, but the running HTTP-tested daemon predates that final patch.
reviewConclusion.associationRegression: 1 passed; 0 failed; temporary SafeBrain/SQLite failure then retry without duplicate memory/link
reviewConclusion.capture: Unresolved acceptance blocker separate from CUA window availability: two actual app-scoped helper runs emitted only zero-amplitude PCM. Correct SOURCE/READY and final flush prove lifecycle/protocol, not usable audio. Cause remains unproven.
reviewConclusion.nativeUi: Full Record lifecycle, real mic plus far-side call, native IPC/frontend assembly/save and interruption recovery have not passed integrated Computer Use acceptance.
reviewConclusion.historicalData: Three older completed synthetic triages retained notes/cards/catalogue content but lacked project association after the obsolete installed sidecar drained their backlog. Repair via original idempotent recording payload remains pending in this review.
coverageLimits: 120 checks cover three short paraphrases across six selected projects, not arbitrary meeting accuracy, long calls, diarization or every failure mode.
The backend routes tasks to the project selected by the recording; this does not prove autonomous cross-project inference.
Cards are deliberately unassigned and unexecuted; owner/deadline text is not structured task scheduling.
The direct Whisper upload fixtures passed three synthetic clips with negation/final-tail cues, but do not validate recording device capture.
Build/test preservation is unit-tested with temporary artifacts and fake processes; no real native build was run after the tooling patch.
